roots.descriptionZh: 从微积分出发，沿微分方程、复分析、调和分析与测度理论进入现代泛函分析；年代说明研究方向的形成，不代表每个词条的发明时间。
roots.descriptionEn: From calculus through differential equations, complex and harmonic analysis, measure theory and functional analysis. Periods describe the emergence of directions, not the invention date of every term.

children.descriptionZh: 变化率、累积量与极限构成后续分析的共同语言。
children.descriptionEn: Rates of change, accumulation and limits provide a common language for analysis.

children.descriptionZh: 实数、常用函数、图形与基本不等式连接代数表达和连续变化。
children.descriptionEn: Real numbers, familiar functions, graphs and basic inequalities connect algebraic expressions with continuous change.

children.descriptionZh: 以收敛刻画无限过程，并研究级数展开和求和。
children.descriptionEn: Convergence describes infinite processes, series expansions and summation.

children.descriptionZh: 从导数和链式法则扩展到偏导、梯度与向量微分。
children.descriptionEn: Derivatives and the chain rule extend to partial derivatives, gradients and vector calculus.

children.descriptionZh: 积累、面积与微分积分之间的联系，以及线积分和多重积分。
children.descriptionEn: Accumulation, area, the relation between differentiation and integration, and line and multiple integrals.

children.periodZh: 17世纪形成微积分；19世纪推进严格化
children.periodEn: Calculus formed in the 17th century; rigor developed in the 19th century

sources.title: MacTutor: The rise of calculus

children.descriptionZh: 由力学与连续介质问题发展出解的存在性、演化、稳定性和变分方法。
children.descriptionEn: Problems in mechanics and continuous media lead to existence, evolution, stability and variational methods.

children.descriptionZh: 初值问题、求解方法、线性系统及周期系数方程。
children.descriptionEn: Initial-value problems, solution methods, linear systems and equations with periodic coefficients.

children.descriptionZh: 以泛函驻值研究运动、守恒、最短路径及边界问题。
children.descriptionEn: Stationary functionals describe motion, conservation, extremal paths and boundary problems.

children.zh: 偏微分方程与边值问题
children.en: Partial differential equations and boundary problems
children.descriptionZh: 多变量场的局部方程、边界条件、基本解和连续介质模型。
children.descriptionEn: Local equations for fields, boundary conditions, fundamental solutions and continuum models.

children.descriptionZh: 线性波动与非线性波方程，以及可积结构和变换。
children.descriptionEn: Linear and nonlinear wave equations, integrable structures and transformations.

children.descriptionZh: 轨道、流、返回映射、不变结构与遍历观点。
children.descriptionEn: Orbits, flows, return maps, invariant structures and ergodic viewpoints.

children.descriptionZh: 稳定性与失稳、吸引子、分岔以及复杂非线性演化。
children.descriptionEn: Stability and instability, attractors, bifurcations and complex nonlinear evolution.

children.periodZh: 17—18世纪方程方法；19—20世纪定性理论
children.periodEn: Equation methods in the 17th–18th centuries; qualitative theories in the 19th–20th

sources.title: MacTutor: An overview of the history of mathematics
MacTutor: A history of topology

children.descriptionZh: 复变函数、解析延拓和特殊函数共同连接积分方法、几何与物理方程。
children.descriptionEn: Complex functions, analytic continuation and special functions connect integral methods, geometry and physical equations.

children.zh: 全纯函数与复几何方法
children.descriptionZh: 全纯性、留数、奇点、共形映射与黎曼曲面。
children.descriptionEn: Holomorphicity, residues, singularities, conformal maps and Riemann surfaces.

children.descriptionZh: 微分方程和积分表示产生的函数族、椭圆函数与正交系统。
children.descriptionEn: Function families arising from differential equations and integral representations, elliptic functions and orthogonal systems.

children.en: Analytic number theory and automorphic functions
children.descriptionZh: 狄利克雷级数、L函数、模形式与迹公式把复分析和调和分析连接到数论。
children.descriptionEn: Dirichlet series, L-functions, modular forms and trace formulas connect complex and harmonic analysis to number theory.

children.periodZh: 19世纪形成复函数论；特殊函数有更早的计算来源
children.periodEn: Complex function theory formed in the 19th century; special functions have earlier computational roots

sources.title: MacTutor: An overview of the history of mathematics

children.descriptionZh: 从热方程中的傅里叶方法发展到群上的调和分析与时频表示。
children.descriptionEn: Fourier methods for heat flow develop into harmonic analysis on groups and time–frequency representations.

children.zh: 傅里叶分析与群上的调和分析
children.en: Fourier analysis and harmonic analysis on groups
children.descriptionZh: 频率分解、卷积、对偶性及积分算子。
children.descriptionEn: Frequency decompositions, convolution, duality and integral operators.

children.descriptionZh: 拉普拉斯等积分变换，以及采样、谱估计、小波和信号表示，并交叉链接量子傅里叶变换。
children.descriptionEn: Integral transforms such as the Laplace transform, sampling, spectral estimation, wavelets and signal representations, with a cross-link to the quantum Fourier transform.

children.periodZh: 19世纪傅里叶方法；20世纪抽象与离散推广
children.periodEn: Fourier methods in the 19th century; abstract and discrete extensions in the 20th

sources.title: MacTutor: An overview of the history of mathematics

children.descriptionZh: 严格的连续性、可测性与积分理论把实函数研究扩展到一般测度空间。
children.descriptionEn: Rigorous continuity, measurability and integration extend real-function theory to general measure spaces.

children.descriptionZh: 连续、可微、变差与函数空间中的正则性，以及说明边界的典型反例。
children.descriptionEn: Continuity, differentiability, variation and regularity, together with counterexamples that distinguish these properties.

children.descriptionZh: 可测空间、测度、零集、积分收敛与测度的几何应用。
children.descriptionEn: Measurable spaces, measures, null sets, convergence of integrals and geometric uses of measure.

children.periodZh: 19世纪实分析；19世纪末至20世纪初测度理论
children.periodEn: Real analysis in the 19th century; measure theory around the turn of the 20th

sources.title: MacTutor: A history of topology

children.descriptionZh: 以函数空间、对偶和算子研究无限维线性问题，并连接量子理论与偏微分方程。
children.descriptionEn: Function spaces, duality and operators address infinite-dimensional linear problems and connect to quantum theory and PDEs.

children.en: Normed spaces, inner products and duality
children.descriptionZh: 从内积空间到巴拿赫空间、局部凸结构与函数空间的拓扑。
children.descriptionEn: From inner-product spaces to Banach spaces, locally convex structures and topologies on function spaces.

children.descriptionZh: 有界与无界算子、谱分解、算子理想以及不变子空间。
children.descriptionEn: Bounded and unbounded operators, spectral decompositions, operator ideals and invariant subspaces.

children.descriptionZh: C*代数、冯·诺伊曼代数及其表示和量子态。
children.descriptionEn: C*-algebras, von Neumann algebras, their representations and quantum states.

children.descriptionZh: 分布、弱导数、索伯列夫空间及弱解和正则性工具。
children.descriptionEn: Distributions, weak derivatives, Sobolev spaces, weak solutions and regularity tools.

children.periodZh: 19世纪末积分方程推动；20世纪形成抽象理论
children.periodEn: Driven by integral equations in the late 19th century; abstract theories formed in the 20th

sources.title: MacTutor: An overview of the history of mathematics
MacTutor: A history of topology
MacTutor: The rise of calculus
MacTutor: An overview of the history of mathematics

roots.descriptionZh: 由位置几何、连续变形和收敛问题发展出的空间研究；同调、流形和抽象同伦构成互相联系的分支。
roots.descriptionEn: The study of spaces grows from geometry of position, continuous deformation and convergence, linking homology, manifolds and abstract homotopy.

children.descriptionZh: 曲面、孔洞与纽结把几何研究引向不依赖长度的性质。
children.descriptionEn: Surfaces, holes and knots direct geometry toward properties independent of length.

children.en: Surfaces, manifolds and examples of spaces
children.descriptionZh: 低维流形、曲面分解与展示拓扑现象的典型空间。
children.descriptionEn: Low-dimensional manifolds, surface decompositions and spaces illustrating topological phenomena.

children.descriptionZh: 嵌入曲线、链环及区分它们的群、多项式和数值不变量。
children.descriptionEn: Embedded curves, links and their group, polynomial and numerical invariants.

children.periodZh: 18世纪位置几何；19世纪曲面与纽结
children.periodEn: Geometry of position in the 18th century; surfaces and knots in the 19th

sources.title: MacTutor: A history of topology

children.descriptionZh: 由实分析中的极限抽象出开集、拓扑空间和连续映射。
children.descriptionEn: Limits in real analysis motivate abstract open sets, topological spaces and continuous maps.

children.descriptionZh: 拓扑的基本语言及子空间、积空间和商空间等构造。
children.descriptionEn: The basic language of topology and constructions such as subspaces, products and quotients.

children.descriptionZh: 度量、邻域、网与滤子，以及分离和可数性条件。
children.descriptionEn: Metrics, neighbourhoods, nets and filters, together with separation and countability conditions.

children.zh: 紧致性、连通性与完备现象
children.descriptionZh: 控制空间整体行为的有限覆盖、连通性、完备性与纲。
children.descriptionEn: Finite covers, connectedness, completeness and category control global behaviour of spaces.

children.periodZh: 19世纪末至20世纪初形成公理化框架
children.periodEn: Axiomatic frameworks formed around the turn of the 20th century

sources.title: MacTutor: A history of topology

children.descriptionZh: 把空间与映射转化为群、链复形和同调不变量。
children.descriptionEn: Spaces and maps are studied through groups, chain complexes and homological invariants.

children.descriptionZh: 路径、覆盖、同伦群以及从局部拼接空间的方法。
children.descriptionEn: Paths, coverings, homotopy groups and ways to assemble spaces from local pieces.

children.descriptionZh: 链、胞腔、同调运算、对偶与分层计算工具。
children.descriptionEn: Chains, cells, cohomology operations, duality and staged computational tools.

children.descriptionZh: 局部平凡结构、分类空间、特征类与拓扑K理论。
children.descriptionEn: Locally trivial structures, classifying spaces, characteristic classes and topological K-theory.

children.periodZh: 19世纪末庞加莱的方法；20世纪系统发展
children.periodEn: Poincaré’s methods in the late 19th century; systematic development in the 20th

sources.title: MacTutor: A history of topology

children.descriptionZh: 用光滑结构、临界点、配边和手术研究流形。
children.descriptionEn: Smooth structures, critical points, cobordisms and surgery are used to study manifolds.
children.periodZh: 20世纪形成并发展
children.periodEn: Formed and developed in the 20th century

sources.title: MacTutor: A history of topology

children.descriptionZh: 模型范畴、单纯对象和高阶语言组织同伦及其代数化。
children.descriptionEn: Model categories, simplicial objects and higher structures organize homotopy and its algebraic forms.

sources.title: MacTutor: A history of topology

roots.descriptionZh: 从度量与形状，经坐标、曲率和变换，发展到代数、辛与现代几何结构。
roots.descriptionEn: From measurement and shape through coordinates, curvature and transformations to algebraic, symplectic and modern geometric structures.

children.descriptionZh: 古典构形经过坐标化和射影方法扩展到更一般的空间。
children.descriptionEn: Classical configurations expand through coordinates and projective methods to more general spaces.

children.descriptionZh: 角、长度、面积与经典平面和球面构形。
children.descriptionEn: Angles, lengths, areas and classical planar and spherical configurations.

children.descriptionZh: 坐标、代数曲线、射影空间与平行公设的推广。
children.descriptionEn: Coordinates, algebraic curves, projective spaces and alternatives to the parallel postulate.

children.zh: 多面体、多胞形与离散构形
children.descriptionZh: 多面体的高维推广、规则构形与格点堆积。
children.descriptionEn: Higher-dimensional polyhedra, regular configurations and lattice packing.

children.periodZh: 古代几何；17世纪坐标方法；19世纪射影与非欧几何
children.periodEn: Ancient geometry; coordinates in the 17th century; projective and non-Euclidean geometry in the 19th

sources.title: MacTutor: Non-Euclidean geometry

children.descriptionZh: 以微积分研究曲线、曲面，再进入流形、度量和联络。
children.descriptionEn: Calculus studies curves and surfaces, then manifolds, metrics and connections.

children.zh: 曲线与曲面的局部几何
children.en: Local geometry of curves and surfaces
children.descriptionZh: 切线、标架、曲率与基本形式刻画局部形状。
children.descriptionEn: Tangents, frames, curvature and fundamental forms describe local shape.

children.descriptionZh: 流形上的切空间、张量运算、微分形式与积分。
children.descriptionEn: Tangent spaces, tensor operations, differential forms and integration on manifolds.

children.descriptionZh: 黎曼及伪黎曼度量、内蕴曲率与时空几何。
children.descriptionEn: Riemannian and pseudo-Riemannian metrics, intrinsic curvature and spacetime geometry.

children.zh: 纤维丛、联络与规范结构
children.descriptionZh: 丛上的微分、平行移动、整体联络和规范场的几何。
children.descriptionEn: Differentiation on bundles, parallel transport, global connections and the geometry of gauge fields.

children.periodZh: 18世纪曲线曲面理论；19世纪高斯与黎曼的内蕴观点
children.periodEn: Curve and surface theory in the 18th century; intrinsic geometry of Gauss and Riemann in the 19th

sources.title: MacTutor: An overview of the history of mathematics
MacTutor: Chronology for 1850–1860

children.descriptionZh: 以多项式方程研究曲线与簇，再引入概形、层和模空间。
children.descriptionEn: Polynomial equations lead from curves and varieties to schemes, sheaves and moduli spaces.

children.zh: 代数曲线、簇与有理映射
children.en: Algebraic curves, varieties and rational maps
children.descriptionZh: 方程的几何、奇点、双有理方法与经典枚举问题。
children.descriptionEn: The geometry of equations, singularities, birational methods and classical enumerative problems.

children.descriptionZh: 用局部环、概形和层表达局部到整体的代数几何。
children.descriptionEn: Local rings, schemes and sheaves express local-to-global algebraic geometry.

children.zh: 交点理论与几何上同调
children.descriptionZh: 代数闭链、除子、交数与不同上同调理论。
children.descriptionEn: Algebraic cycles, divisors, intersections and cohomology theories.

children.descriptionZh: 分类空间、叠和导出结构描述成族的几何对象及现代交叉方向。
children.descriptionEn: Moduli spaces, stacks and derived structures describe families of geometric objects and modern connections.

children.periodZh: 19世纪曲线与簇；20世纪概形与层；现代导出推广
children.periodEn: Curves and varieties in the 19th century; schemes and sheaves in the 20th; modern derived extensions

sources.title: MacTutor: An overview of the history of mathematics
MacTutor: Alexander Grothendieck

children.descriptionZh: 几何对称性组织为连续群、李代数及齐性空间。
children.descriptionEn: Geometric symmetries organize into continuous groups, Lie algebras and homogeneous spaces.
children.periodZh: 19世纪后期变换群观点；20世纪结构与表示理论
children.periodEn: Transformation-group viewpoint in the late 19th century; structure and representation theories in the 20th

sources.title: MacTutor: An overview of the history of mathematics

children.descriptionZh: 从哈密顿力学发展出的相空间结构、括号和动量映射。
children.descriptionEn: Phase-space structures, brackets and momentum maps develop from Hamiltonian mechanics.
children.periodZh: 19世纪力学背景；20世纪形成几何分支
children.periodEn: Mechanics in the 19th century; geometric branches formed in the 20th

sources.title: MacTutor: Hamiltonian terminology and its origins

children.zh: 复几何与现代交叉方向
children.descriptionZh: 复结构、几何分析及量子和非交换观点延伸古典几何。
children.descriptionEn: Complex structures, geometric analysis, quantum and noncommutative viewpoints extend classical geometry.

children.descriptionZh: 复结构、厄米度量、凯勒流形和霍奇理论。
children.descriptionEn: Complex structures, Hermitian metrics, Kähler manifolds and Hodge theory.

children.descriptionZh: 用偏微分方程研究度量、极小曲面、嵌入及谱几何。
children.descriptionEn: PDEs study metrics, minimal surfaces, embeddings and spectral geometry.

children.zh: 量子、镜像与非交换几何
children.descriptionZh: 量子场论、镜像对称和非交换代数带来的几何结构。
children.descriptionEn: Geometric structures arising from quantum field theory, mirror symmetry and noncommutative algebras.

sources.title: MacTutor: An overview of the history of mathematics
MacTutor: Non-Euclidean geometry
MacTutor: Chronology for 1850–1860

roots.descriptionZh: 从随机试验与误差研究，进入分布、统计推断、随机过程和随机分析。
roots.descriptionEn: From random experiments and errors to distributions, statistical inference, stochastic processes and stochastic analysis.

children.descriptionZh: 古典随机事件的计算逐步发展为测度化的概率语言。
children.descriptionEn: Classical calculations of random events develop into measure-theoretic probability.

children.zh: 事件、概率空间与随机变量
children.en: Events, probability spaces and random variables
children.descriptionZh: 样本空间、条件概率、独立性与随机变量的基本量。
children.descriptionEn: Sample spaces, conditional probability, independence and basic quantities of random variables.

children.descriptionZh: 常见分布、特征函数、矩与大数法则和中心极限现象。
children.descriptionEn: Common distributions, characteristic functions, moments and laws of large numbers and central limits.

children.periodZh: 17世纪古典概率；20世纪测度公理化
children.periodEn: Classical probability in the 17th century; measure-theoretic axioms in the 20th

sources.title: MacTutor: An overview of the history of mathematics
MacTutor: Andrey Kolmogorov

children.descriptionZh: 从观测与误差出发，用模型、估计和检验推断总体规律。
children.descriptionEn: Models, estimation and testing infer population behaviour from observations and errors.

children.descriptionZh: 样本信息、似然、充分性与区间估计。
children.descriptionEn: Sample information, likelihood, sufficiency and interval estimation.

children.descriptionZh: 比较假设、拟合关系和设计观测，并量化不确定性。
children.descriptionEn: Compare hypotheses, fit relationships, design observations and quantify uncertainty.

children.periodZh: 19世纪误差与拟合；19世纪末至20世纪现代统计
children.periodEn: Errors and fitting in the 19th century; modern statistics from the late 19th into the 20th

sources.title: MacTutor: Earliest uses of symbols in probability and statistics

children.descriptionZh: 研究随时间与空间变化的随机量及其演化方程。
children.descriptionEn: Random quantities evolving through time and space and the equations governing them.

children.zh: 随机游动、马尔可夫过程与时间序列
children.en: Random walks, Markov processes and time series
children.descriptionZh: 转移、平稳性、跳跃和随时间变化的随机序列。
children.descriptionEn: Transitions, stationarity, jumps and time-dependent random sequences.

children.zh: 鞅、随机积分与随机微分方程
children.descriptionZh: 适应性、停时、二次变差、随机积分及扩散方程。
children.descriptionEn: Adaptedness, stopping times, quadratic variation, stochastic integrals and diffusion equations.

children.zh: 随机场、随机矩阵与随机几何
children.descriptionZh: 高维随机结构及概率与几何、统计物理的联系。
children.descriptionEn: High-dimensional random structures and connections with geometry and statistical physics.

children.periodZh: 19世纪随机运动背景；20世纪过程与随机分析理论
children.periodEn: Random-motion background in the 19th century; process theory and stochastic analysis in the 20th

sources.title: MacTutor: Andrey Kolmogorov
MacTutor: An overview of the history of mathematics
MacTutor: Earliest uses of symbols in probability and statistics
MacTutor: Andrey Kolmogorov

roots.descriptionZh: 从可计算近似到矩阵、微分方程与优化算法，关注误差、稳定性和科学计算。
roots.descriptionEn: From computable approximations to matrix, differential-equation and optimization algorithms, with attention to error, stability and scientific computing.

children.descriptionZh: 近似表示与求积拥有长期历史，现代计算进一步要求可控制的舍入误差。
children.descriptionEn: Approximation and quadrature have a long history; modern computing also requires control of rounding error.

children.descriptionZh: 多项式和基函数逼近、求根、数值积分及微分。
children.descriptionEn: Polynomial and basis-function approximation, root finding, numerical integration and differentiation.

children.zh: 数值表示、误差与稳定性
children.descriptionZh: 浮点运算、条件数、舍入、截断以及误差传播。
children.descriptionEn: Floating-point arithmetic, conditioning, rounding, truncation and propagation of errors.

children.periodZh: 古典计算方法延续至19世纪；20世纪计算机误差分析
children.periodEn: Classical methods through the 19th century; computer error analysis in the 20th

sources.title: SIAM: The history of numerical analysis and scientific computing

children.descriptionZh: 方程组、矩阵分解、特征问题和大规模迭代方法。
children.descriptionEn: Linear systems, matrix factorizations, eigenproblems and large-scale iterative methods.
children.periodZh: 古典消元与19世纪矩阵理论；20世纪大规模计算
children.periodEn: Classical elimination and 19th-century matrix theory; large-scale computation in the 20th

sources.title: SIAM: The history of numerical analysis and scientific computing

children.descriptionZh: 把连续时间与空间问题转化为可计算的离散问题。
children.descriptionEn: Continuous time and space problems are converted into computable discrete problems.

children.zh: 时间步进与常微分方程
children.en: Time stepping and ordinary differential equations
children.descriptionZh: 一步、多步和预测校正方法，以及随机步进和稳定性。
children.descriptionEn: One-step, multistep and predictor–corrector methods, stochastic stepping and stability.

children.zh: 空间离散、有限元与谱方法
children.en: Spatial discretization, finite elements and spectral methods
children.descriptionZh: 网格、弱形式、基函数与边界方法求解偏微分方程。
children.descriptionEn: Meshes, weak forms, basis functions and boundary methods solve PDEs.

children.periodZh: 18—19世纪步进法；20世纪有限元、谱法与科学计算
children.periodEn: Time stepping in the 18th–19th centuries; finite elements, spectral methods and scientific computing in the 20th

sources.title: SIAM: The history of numerical analysis and scientific computing

children.descriptionZh: 由极值和变分问题进入凸性、约束、最优控制和运筹决策。
children.descriptionEn: Extrema and variational problems lead to convexity, constraints, optimal control and operational decisions.

children.descriptionZh: 凸集、凸函数、对偶与约束为优化算法提供结构。
children.descriptionEn: Convex sets and functions, duality and constraints provide structure for optimization algorithms.

children.descriptionZh: 梯度、规划、约束最优性以及动态系统的控制。
children.descriptionEn: Gradients, programming, constrained optimality and the control of dynamical systems.

children.zh: 博弈、资源配置与多目标决策
children.descriptionZh: 多方目标、均衡、资源配置与经济优化中的数学结构。
children.descriptionEn: Mathematical structures of interacting objectives, equilibrium, allocation and economic optimization.

children.periodZh: 18世纪极值方法；20世纪凸优化与运筹学
children.periodEn: Extremal methods in the 18th century; convex optimization and operations research in the 20th

children.descriptionZh: 计算机推动数值模型、随机模拟、快速变换与高维近似。
children.descriptionEn: Computers enable numerical models, random simulation, fast transforms and high-dimensional approximation.
